title: How Singapore’s F1 Grand Prix Became The ‘Coachella of Asia’
summary: "No other festival in Asia possesses comparable buying power or influence" as the Singapore GP, WME's Brett Murrihy says.
body: SINGAPORE — With its combination of speed, glamor, artistry and science, Formula 1 is a spectacle that travels at a speed and sound nothing else can match. It was Red Bull’s Max Verstappen who bagged the 2026 Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix earlier this month with a pole-to-checkered flag win, an historic deed for the flying Dutchman who finally conquered a race that had eluded him for a decade . If Verstappen was the king of the track, The Killers, Janet Jackson, Split Enz, JJ Lin and Lana Del Rey were the stars of the live show, a music festival that pumps away when the racing pauses. With its flashy street circuit and three-day live music festival, the Singapore GP has a speed and sound quite unlike any other race on the calendar. Established in 2008, senior music industry executives are now calling it the premier annual music festival in Asia. Billboard was there to catch the action Oct. 9-11, both on track and across the event’s 11 live entertainment stages. Neil and Tim Finn of Split Enz perform at the 2026 Singapore Formula 1 Grand Prix. Jared Rezel/Singapore GP Pte Ltd Coachella of Asia Concert promoters pray for sunshine. title: Sharon Osbourne Says ‘Back to the Beginning’ Concert Film Captured Ozzy’s ‘Every Pore, Every Expression’ Before His Death
summary: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back to the Beginning is an in-depth look at the rock icon's swan song.
body: Nearly 16 months later, Sharon Osbourne says that watching Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back to the Beginning — the film of the historic July 5, 2025 concert that was both acts’ swan song before Ozzy Osbourne’s death 17 days later at age 76 — is still “very hard” for her. The nearly two-and-a-half-hour film arrives in more than 15,000 theaters in 132 countries on Oct. 28, via Trafalgar Releasing and Mercury Studios. “They’ve been working on the film for a long time and I had to see a lot of edits,” Sharon, who attended premieres in both Los Angeles and London, tells Billboard via phone shortly before the latter. “At first I couldn’t; my son (Jack Osbourne) had to do it for me because I couldn’t face doing it. “It’s very hard, because to see (Ozzy) on the big screen, and so close up, you see every pore on his face and every expression in his eyes, and it’s just very, very emotional. And of course his strength of character, to be able to have done that at that point in his life…. He was in agony and had trouble breathing. Google — sorry, Alphabet — is sharing its latest financial report today, detailing the company’s Q3 2026 performance. And as you should only expect, that’s full of tons of data points about AI, token usage, and all things Search. title: Inside the City of Hope Gala: Stevie Nicks, Jackson Browne & More Honor Primary Wave’s Larry Mestel
summary: Nicks concluded the Spirit of Life gala with an acoustic rendition of "Landslide" and remarks about why "City of Hope has meant so much to me."
body: On Tuesday (Oct. 27), City of Hope hosted its annual Spirit of Life gala at the Pacific Design Center in Los Angeles. This year, the organization honored Primary Wave founder/CEO Larry Mestel , who spoke passionately about his support of the organization, even calling Dr. Leo Wang, one of the doctors working with City of Hope, as “the real rock star tonight,” before adding, in a self-deprecating tone: “He cures cancer in children, and I buy music catalogs,” which got a laugh from the crowd. It also featured performances by Melissa Etheridge — a breast cancer survivor herself — along with Jackson Browne and Stevie Nicks , all of whom have professional ties to Mestel and Primary Wave. There was also a virtual performance by Pete Townshend from his home, as he could not attend that night due to a medical reason. title: Amazon’s Echo Time is a $200 camera-free smart clock built for better sleep
summary: The smart clock detects sleep without a wearable.
body: TL;DR The Amazon Echo Time $200 camera-free smart alarm clock is available today. It has sleep detection that wakes you within 10 to 60 minutes of a set alarm time. There is a version for kids that has parent-controlled sleep schedules. Amazon is expanding its smart home devices today, updating some existing ones, and adding something completely new with the Amazon Echo Time. The orb-like smart clock is similar in look to the Echo Spot , and with sleep wellness as its focus, it’s meant for the nightstand. As Amazon explains , the Echo Time is powered by Alexa+, and has “science-backed wind-down and wake-up features” that have been given the National Sleep Foundation’s SleepMark designation for meeting evidence-based sleep health standards. Those include a smart alarm that kicks in within 10 to 60 minutes of a set alarm to wake you up when it detects you’re in a lighter sleep. The Echo Time display brightens as it prepares to wake you, and plays a customizable alarm tone that starts quietly and gradually gets louder every time it’s snoozed, up to four times. At night, the display dims and is limited to just the current time or the time of the next set alarm.

title: DuckDuckGo has a bone to pick with Samsung over Google Search in One UI 9
summary: The search bar looks permanent, but there's more to this Android story.
body: TL;DR DuckDuckGo has called out Samsung for baking Google’s search bar into the One UI 9 home screen, even for users who prefer other search engines. The change builds on Android 17’s revamped search experience, which Motorola also offers on its home screen search bar. Samsung users can remove the search bar through Home screen settings, although some haven’t realized the option exists. Google has plenty of ways to get you searching, but DuckDuckGo isn’t thrilled to see its rival claim another piece of Android real estate. This time, Samsung is caught in the crossfire, where a One UI 9 change puts Google Search front and center, even on phones whose owners prefer DuckDuckGo. The privacy-focused search engine took to X to criticize the change, accusing Google of hardwiring its search bar into Samsung’s home screen. Unlike a conventional widget, you can’t long-press, move, or drag the new bar away. That makes it look like Google has secured a permanent spot on your phone, regardless of your search preferences.

body: ESA/Webb, NASA & CSA, E. Sabbi, M. Zamani (ESA/Webb); Acknowledgement: M. H. Özsaraç In this Webb image released on Oct. 22, 2026, we see a turbulent cauldron of star formation filled with dense clumps of gas. This region is named N159 and is located 161,000 light-years away in the Large Magellanic Cloud, one of the satellite galaxies orbiting the Milky Way galaxy. This region has a lower metallicity (proportion of elements that are heavier than helium and hydrogen) than the Milky Way, giving astronomers an opportunity to learn more about conditions found in the early universe and how stars formed under those conditions. title: I’ve been a T-Mobile subscriber for years, and the carrier just gave me a big reason to stay
summary: Get some decent perks from your T-Mobile plan.
body: It doesn’t feel like that long ago that I used to joke that T-Mobile’s service was fine, unless you liked making calls indoors. However, the company has come a long way in 25 years, and it’s now my preferred carrier for all my testing and personal use. I live in a rural part of Northern New Jersey, and I get excellent signal in the mountains and valleys, and I’ve been impressed with the company’s Ultra Capacity 5G performance. I also switched because of the value and versatility. It costs me less per month on T-Mobile than on AT&T, and T-Mobile is much more flexible, letting me test different phones — including overseas releases without much hassle. I always felt I was saving money with T-Mobile, but the company’s T-Mix announcement has given me a big reason to stick around even longer.

title: Can’t get Pixel VIPs? Here’s how to create a similar experience on your Android phone
summary: You can have an informative contacts hub without needing a Pixel.
body: A while back, I started using Pixel VIPs and became hooked on the way the feature’s hub-like widget made it easy to keep in touch with my most important contacts. But since I use a different, non-Pixel device as my daily driver, I became curious whether I could replicate the experience on other Android phones . While you can’t get a one-to-one replication of the Pixel-exclusive feature, I was surprised by just how close I got by using my phone’s settings, Find Hub, and Google Contacts. Here’s how you can also get a Pixel VIPs experience on your device.

title: Cooling fans are the next big Android phone trend you should avoid
summary: More and more brands want to put a fan-cooled phone in your pocket, but are they worth it?
body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority While not an entirely new trend, the HONOR Win 2 series and OnePlus Ace 7 are just two in a growing list of Android phones launching with cooling fans onboard. What was previously just the purview of niche flagship gaming phones is quickly making its way to more affordable handsets with broader appeal. In theory, this technology makes a lot of sense. PCs, laptops , and even handheld game consoles all have fans to help keep them cool while powering through intense workloads. So why shouldn’t high-performance smartphones benefit too, especially given that they’re constrained by small form factors that struggle to dissipate heat quickly?

title: Galaxy Ring and these Galaxy Watches will get improved sleep apnea detection
summary: Galaxy Watches and Rings will categorize breathing disturbances into one of three levels.
body: TL;DR Samsung has received clearance from the US and Korean Food and Drug Safety authorities for an advanced sleep apnea function. Galaxy Watches and Galaxy Ring will soon be able to categorize breathing disturbances into one of three levels: mild, occasional, or frequent. The feature will start rolling out in November to users in South Korea. Sleep apnea detection has long been a feature on Samsung’s wearables. Watches as old as the Galaxy Watch 4 have offered sleep apnea detection, and the Galaxy Ring became the first FDA-cleared ring device for sleep apnea detection earlier this year. However, the company is now introducing a new, more advanced function that could prove helpful beyond just detecting signs of sleep apnea. Samsung has announced that it received clearance from both the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) for the advanced sleep apnea feature.

title: PSA: Your Discord messages could soon show up on Google, but here’s how to opt out
summary: A little more Google visibility, a little less privacy.
body: TL;DR Discord will begin making messages from eligible public servers available through Google and other search engines in mid-December. The change excludes private servers and DMs, but in many regions, eligible messages will be publicly searchable by default. Users and server admins can opt out before the rollout, but the controls currently require desktop or web access. Discord has become a treasure trove of useful information, but finding it through Google has often felt like a treasure hunt with no map. That could finally change, though some users aren’t thrilled about the possibility of their conversations appearing in Google search results. In a blog post , Discord confirmed plans to make messages from eligible public servers searchable on Google and other search engines starting in mid-December 2026. The company is introducing privacy controls ahead of the rollout, giving both server administrators and individual users a chance to keep their conversations off the wider web.

Pokémon Unite was one of the most loved Pokémon games on Android when it first launched back in 2021. You could play as your favorite Pokémon and join 5v5 battles against other players. title: This Android brand put a 10,000mAh battery in its latest phone, and Samsung needs to up its game

Companies like Samsung and Google, on the other hand, are still offering 5,000mAh to 6,000mAh batteries. New smartphone launches have become so common that it takes something special to really make a mark . There was a time when smartphone makers battled over who could pack the most megapixels into their phone’s camera. Now, we’re seeing something different: battery capacities. Since the advent of silicon-carbon batteries , we’ve seen capacities grow with nearly every new launch. That trend continues today with Xiaomi’s latest smartphone. Now it looks like Google wants its AI assistant to help with something a lot less exciting but much more annoying — setting up your eSIM. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. title: Pixel phones are still missing alarms, turning anxiety dreams into reality

body: TL;DR Pixel owner reports two alarms in a row not going off. They received a notification that said, “Alarm automatically silenced. Your alarm went off and was automatically silenced after the duration you set.” Google is looking into the issue, which echoes past problems with Pixels and the Clock app. Did you ever have that anxiety dream where you sleep through several alarms and miss something major? How about waking up to discover that it was not actually a dream? That’s an actual nightmare, and one that might be the result of a continued problem with the Clock app on Pixels. title: Android opens enrollment for program that brings one-tap sideloading for app stores
summary: Google’s Epic-fueled app store plan starts enrollment.
body: Credit: Andy Walker / Android Authority TL;DR Third-party Android app stores can now enroll in the Registered App Stores program. App stores that enroll will get a new streamlined installation flow when it launches on December 1. This change should make sideloading third-party app stores easier for users. Earlier this year, Google announced plans to roll out a new program that would allow third-party app stores to officially register with Android. The change stems from a proposed settlement between Google and Epic Games from last year. Google has now provided an update on this program. According to the Mountain View-based firm, third-party app stores can now enroll in the Register App Stores program starting today. Enrollment is optional, but the developers who do will get a new streamlined installation flow when it launches on December 1. Stores that don’t enroll won’t see any change in their installation flow. The program is available for devices running Android 17 QPR2 and later for users outside of the US.

title: Google Wallet could borrow a handy transit feature for everyday purchases
summary: Unlocking your phone for contactless payments could soon be optional.
body: TL;DR Google Wallet could soon introduce new verification controls for regular contactless payments, similar to those available for transit payments. A new “Tap to pay” option has been spotted under Google Wallet’s Verification settings. The option currently crashes the app when selected, so it’s unclear what controls or security safeguards Google plans to offer with it. If you’re a Google Walle t user, you know how convenient it is to pay for things with a simple tap of your phone. Of course, that convenience comes with a side of vulnerability, and that’s precisely why Google Wallet always requires you to verify your identity before completing a payment. This verification stays valid for a few minutes before timing out, forcing users to verify their identity again to make subsequent contactless payments. This isn’t a huge inconvenience, but it’s something Google likely wants to give more flexibility around regardless.
